label: Basic
description: Basic collapsible. Best for an order summary that keeps its status in view and opens the shipping address and items.

label: Checkbox Settings
description: Collapsible with checkbox settings. Best for a full-width outline button that opens a card of 3 notification channel checkboxes, starting open.

label: Animated Card
description: Collapsible animated card. Best for a single help question in a small card, where the whole question line opens its answer below.

label: Bottom Trigger
description: Collapsible card with a bottom button. Best for a usage card with a progress bar whose round chevron button, centred on the bottom edge, opens a cost breakdown.

label: Form Fields
description: Collapsible form fields. Best for a price input with a sliders icon button beside it that reveals tax rate and discount fields, its open state held in state.

label: In Frame
description: Collapsible status card. Best for a deployment note open on load, its whole header row toggling the release summary.

label: Nested List
description: Collapsible list with actions. Best for a list of 3 API keys under a toggling header, each row's menu copying its key or deleting the row.

label: User Profile
description: Collapsible profile. Best for a handle with an avatar that opens to last activity, an online since time and a country flag for location.

label: Multi-Level Menu
description: Multi-level collapsible menu. Best for a 3 level menu of icon rows where folders open in place and the chosen row stays highlighted.

label: File Tree
description: File tree with file actions. Best for a code file explorer under Explorer and Outline tabs, file rows showing download and delete buttons.
